name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 and brought in 5 leads at a cost per lead of $43.90 across 11,850 impressions and 150 clicks.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads on $153.40 spend, with 8,800 impressions, 120 clicks, a 1.4% click rate, and a cost per lead of $30.68.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate, but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Month-to-date in November 2026, Meta has taken $487.00 in spend with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 86.8% were contacted, 44.7% converted to applicants, 26.3% applied, 10.5% were hired, and 21.1% were lost after conversion.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is mature and shows the strongest hiring rate so far: 90.0% contacted, 50.0% converted, 30.0% applied, 12.5% hired, and 22.5% lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge rates yet.
